description: Source file implementing weakly linked functions for device info retrieval, configuration, and event handling, with support for RBUS integration.

methods.name: getDeviceBootTime
methods.description: Returns a string representing device boot time.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the device serial number.

methods.name: getProductClass
methods.description: Returns the product class of the device.

methods.name: getModelName
methods.description: Returns the model name.

methods.name: getPartnerID
methods.description: Returns the partner ID.

methods.name: getAccountID
methods.description: Returns the account ID.

methods.name: getRebootReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for reboot.

methods.name: getFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version.

methods.name: get_deviceMAC
methods.description: Returns device MAC address.

methods.name: get_deviceWanMAC
methods.description: Returns device WAN MAC address.

methods.name: getTimeOffset
methods.description: Returns time offset, currently always 0.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpgradeStartTime
methods.description: Returns firmware upgrade start time, currently NULL.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpgradeEndTime
methods.description: Returns firmware upgrade end time, currently NULL.

methods.name: get_global_systemReadyTime
methods.description: Returns global system ready time.

methods.name: set_global_systemReadyTime
methods.description: Sets global system ready time.

methods.name: setForceSync
methods.description: Weak function to set force sync, supports RBUS.

methods.name: getForceSync
methods.description: Weak function to get force sync status, supports RBUS.

methods.name: Get_Webconfig_URL
methods.description: Weak function to get web configuration URL.

methods.name: Set_Webconfig_URL
methods.description: Weak function to set web configuration URL.

methods.name: Get_Supplementary_URL
methods.description: Weak function to get supplementary URL.

methods.name: Set_Supplementary_URL
methods.description: Weak function to set supplementary URL.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Weak function to set device parameters, supports RBUS.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Weak function to send notifications, supports RBUS.

methods.name: registerWebcfgEvent
methods.description: Registers web configuration event, supports RBUS.

methods.name: unregisterWebcfgEvent
methods.description: Unregisters web configuration event, supports RBUS.

methods.name: mapStatus
methods.description: Maps internal status codes to WDMP status, supports RBUS.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets device attributes, weak implementation.

methods.name: rbus_GetValueFromDB
methods.description: Weak function to get value from RBUS database.

methods.name: rbus_StoreValueIntoDB
methods.description: Weak function to store value into RBUS database.

methods.name: rbus_waitUntilSystemReady
methods.description: Weak function to wait until system is ready.
